extracted.name: Katori chaat
ingredient_lines: Hung curd or simple plain yogurt
Plain bhujia or thin sev indian
instruction_lines: Make oil hot. Make dough of flour,semolina and corn flour and also add salt and black pepper. Make hard dough.
Make balls of it and roll out them.make thin layered tortilla and punch with fork all over
Cut out by cookie cutter or steel glass.spread every small poori on a small katori or cereal bowl
Let it deep fry on low flame to make crunchy hard katori
Let it cool down and fill with first beans,then onion,green chilli,tomatoes and coriander.
Now pour some chutneys and chaat masala and pinch of salt and peppers.enjoy
